attempts.raw: {"risk": 5, "reason": "This removes public obsolete virtual overload methods (e.g., Display(TModel), Edit(TModel), Update(...) with IUpdateModel) from base display driver classes, which is a breaking API change for any downstream module or theme that still overrides those legacy signatures—their overrides will silently stop being called since the base class no longer routes to them."}

reason: This removes public obsolete virtual overload methods (e.g., Display(TModel), Edit(TModel), Update(...) with IUpdateModel) from base display driver classes, which is a breaking API change for any downstream module or theme that still overrides those legacy signatures—their overrides will silently stop being called since the base class no longer routes to them.
